_probe.why: FLOSS/.env sets FLOSS_MODEL_BACKEND=omniroute (ADR-19), so every voter resolves through OmniRoute. Model IDs below were each confirmed with a live one-token completion through that exact path. OmniRoute's own catalog reports status:'available' for models that 404 on contact, so catalog status is NOT accepted as evidence here -- only a recorded successful completion is.
_probe.id_format: OmniRoute requires a provider/model prefix; bare model ids are rejected as ambiguous.

removed_because_dead.cerebras/gpt-oss-120b: 404. Was in balanced/fast/diverse/diverse-plus/diverse-max/yumeichan -- i.e. the DEFAULT profile. OmniRoute returns an error naming a DIFFERENT model ('zai-glm-4.7 is archived') than the one requested and the cooldown keeps resetting, so the error appears cached per-provider rather than per-model.
removed_because_dead.groq/meta-llama/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-in: 404 no access. Was in diverse-max and post-window.
removed_because_dead.flowith/*: CORRECTED 2026-08-18: flowith voters do NOT route through OmniRoute or litellm -- build_default_voters dispatches any `flowith/` model to make_flowith_voter, a bespoke direct HTTPS call to FLOWITH_API_URL (https://edge.flowith.io/external/use/llm) authenticated from ~/.flowith/credentials.json. An OmniRoute 'no active credentials' result therefore says nothing about flowith. Probed on the REAL path instead: the credential file exists and loads cleanly, but the endpoint returns HTTP 404 Not Found for gemini-2.5-flash, deepseek-chat, and gpt-4.1-mini alike -- the endpoint itself is gone, not the models. Removed for that reason. Note this is the WORST failure shape available: because the credential file is present, _flowith_credential_state reports the provider as available, so these voters passed the include_unavailable=False gate and would have been enrolled in a poll only to fail at request time.
removed_because_dead.ollama/gemma3:12b-it-qat: OmniRoute reports 'No active credentials for provider: ollama' EVEN WHILE the local ollama server answers normally on :11434. The local model is fine; OmniRoute simply has no route to it. This is why ADR-18's reuse-review profile could never reach three surfaces. See the `local` profile note.

_probe.independence_rule: Nontrivial polls need >=3 provider surfaces and >=4 model families; same-family endpoints on different surfaces do NOT count as independent (groq/qwen and huggingface/Qwen are one family). Before this repair the default `balanced` profile degraded to two voters BOTH on groq once cerebras died, silently failing its own bar.
_probe.falsifier: Re-probe before relying on this. Failures may be transient quota or circuit-breaker state, and a restored credential (notably flowith/ollama) would change these verdicts.
_probe.local_profile_note: The `local` profile intentionally still names ollama/gemma3:12b-it-qat. The model is genuinely healthy -- probed directly against http://localhost:11434 on 2026-08-18 and it answered. What is broken is only the ROUTE: with FLOSS_MODEL_BACKEND=omniroute (the current default) OmniRoute has no ollama credential and returns 'No active credentials for provider: ollama'. Pointing this profile at a hosted model to make it 'pass' would have made the name a lie. To actually use it, either run with FLOSS_MODEL_BACKEND=litellm or add an ollama connection in OmniRoute.
_probe.lesson: Probe the path the code actually takes. A voter's transport is decided by build_default_voters dispatch (voter-name prefix, then model prefix, else litellm/OmniRoute), NOT by the model string alone -- an initial pass here wrongly declared flowith dead from an OmniRoute error on a path flowith never uses, and reached the right answer only after re-probing correctly.
_probe._verified_working_shape: Structured on 2026-08-21. These were free-text strings ('OpenAI-oss family | groq surface | 489ms'), which meant independence_rule below could be stated but never checked -- and two profiles violated it unnoticed. tests/test_voter_independence.py now enforces the rule against this map, so a profile that drops under the bar fails a test instead of quietly voting.
